label: EXPERIMENTAL / OOD
question: Within a win or a draw, does calibrating the spread of total goals without moving its mean improve the first exact score or the ordered three?
population: Use the original R25-registered R5 panel and R7 fitted model archives and their SHA-256 hashes. Fit on all 2,291 regular-phase matches before 2025 using only their date-causal R7 anchor probabilities. Select on the 218 regular-phase matches in the first half of 2025 against their archived R7 predictions. Evaluate separately on the 162 matches in the second half of 2025 and the 150 regular-phase matches in the original 2026/27 panel. The latter slices are date-separated for this recipe and have appeared in earlier project research.
method: For each match and each WDL outcome, tilt the conditional total-goals distribution by exp(beta*g(n)+alpha*n). The fixed function g(n) equals n*(n-1)/2 through six goals, continuing linearly above six with slope 5.5. Solve alpha by bisection to match the prior conditional mean. The prior WDL probabilities and the relative score probabilities at the same outcome and total are preserved. Estimate one beta for all wins and another for draws using the actual training outcomes and totals and minimized negative log likelihood plus 16*beta^2, with bounds [-0.22,0.22]. Round fitted coefficients to six decimal places. Use the signed prior WDL and actual-line side selections in all score arms for an isolated test. Verify maximum mean and WDL probability error at 2e-12.
selection: Use doses 0, 0.5 and 1 as mixture weights between the signed R7 grid and the adjusted grid. Dose zero retains the original R7 picks. On validation admit only doses that at least tie R7 on first exact hits and three-score hits. Select most first hits, then most three hits, then lowest exact score log loss, then smaller dose. Replay the selected and fixed nonzero doses on both holdout slices and their union. Report first and three hits, WDL, actual-line result, all availability denominators, exact log loss, gains and losses, and whole-date paired intervals against R7 and market where present. Use ordered trio membership for hits and report the number of changed firsts and changed memberships.
forward: A positive selected dose with combined first-score gain or combined three-score gain and no loss in the other score metric is eligible for a new independent J1 pregame research comparison. If eligible, use the same fitting inputs and fixed coefficients on the next complete registered slate with contemporaneous R7 inputs, freeze any research scores and their ranked seats before kickoff, and compare to the signed R7 firsts at the same cutoff. If the screen fails, finish the recipe as a development diagnostic. Formal stage windows use their original public first-display and strict actual-line protocol.
